description: APIkit for SOAP (SOAPkit) is used to expose a SOAP webservice behind an HTTPS listener:            with the WSDL containing the conventional placeholder for `soap:address`:        At runtime, SOAPkit replaces that address with the actual endpoint URL. Our workaround now is to expose the webservice not only over HTTPS but also over HTTP. However, this is not a solution for security-conscious organisations.
clean_text: WSDL retrieved from SOAPkit via HTTPS has HTTP soap:address only on CloudHub. APIkit for SOAP (SOAPkit) is used to expose a SOAP webservice behind an HTTPS listener: with the WSDL containing the conventional placeholder for `soap:address`: At runtime, SOAPkit replaces that address with the actual endpoint URL. This works fine on localhost: But when the same app is deployed to CloudHub, the address which SOAPkit inserts uses HTTP instead of HTTPS: Because that webservice listens only on HTTPS and not on HTTP, HTTP requests to that endpoint URL will fail. Our workaround now is to expose the webservice not only over HTTPS but also over HTTP. However, this is not a solution for security-conscious organisations.
